title: sdr-daily-scratchpad-taylor-ng-2026-03-04
content:
Morning plan:
- Quick review of yesterday: 18 dials, 3 connects, 1 demo booked (Acme Inc).
- Goal today: 40 dials, 6 connects, 2 demos booked.
- Focus accounts: Enterprise AI, MedTech, FinServ (prioritize by inbound activity + product-fit tags).

Top-of-day call list (1st pass - priority):
1) Meridian Health (VP Product - Sara Li) — reached out 2026-03-02, interested in private deployment. Notes: evaluating infra/hostname requirements. Call goal: confirm compliance timeline + intro to solutions eng. If no answer, follow-up email w/ short checklist.
2) Orion Financial (Head of Platform - Marcus Reed) — open to demo; needs latency/cost numbers for 100k daily tokens. Prep: bring Redwood Dedicated cost examples, batching/quantization notes.
3) Vertex Labs (CTO - Nina Alvarez) — liked hosted API for quick POC. Objection: lock-in concerns. Use playbook snippet: "same API across hosted/dedicated/private" + migration plan.
4) Acme Retail (Head of ML Ops - Dan Cho) — demo booked tomorrow 2026-03-05, send pre-demo checklist (data samples, expected QPS, sequence length).
5) Helix Security (Dir Eng - Omar Patel) — inbound compliance questions. Need to loop security. Action: cc security@redwood + ask for SOC2/KMS doc.

Follow-ups (email snippets / quick copy):
- Subject: Quick follow on Redwood demo availability
  Body: Hi {first_name}, thanks for the chat earlier. Quick note to confirm availability for a 30m demo tomorrow at {time}. I’ll share a short pre-demo checklist so we can tailor the session (samples, QPS, compliance needs). Cheers, Taylor

- Subject: Redwood Dedicated — example numbers for 100k tokens/day
  Body: Hi {first_name}, attaching ballpark unit economics for Dedicated + Hosted fallback. Key levers: batching, quantization profile, prefix caching. Happy to run a short model-fit call w/ your SREs.

Dispositions to use in CRM: left-voicemail, no-answer, interested-needs-demo, not-a-fit, send-resource, follow-up-in-3w.

Pipeline quick notes (opportunity snapshots):
- Meridian Health: MED-234 — high ACV, security gating. Next: schedule compliance intake, AE handoff.
- Orion Financial: FIN-110 — POC request for latency/cost. Next: prepare sample numbers + demo.
- Vertex Labs: DEV-78 — low friction, risk of churn (evaluating 3 vendors). Next: emphasize migration story, customer wins.

Admin / tasks:
- Update Salesforce with call outcomes immediately after each call.
- Log any technical Qs in CRM thread and add label "needs-engineer".
- Send pre-demo packet to Acme Retail by EOD.
- Remind Dan (Acme) to upload sample payloads to S3 link before demo.

Ideas / playbook tweaks (notes to self):
- Create a 1-page "dedicated vs hosted" one-pager that has concrete latency/cost examples for 50k/100k/500k tokens/day — engineering to validate but useful for AE.
- Shorten pre-demo checklist to 5 must-haves (samples, peak QPS, SLA Qs, security contacts, expected inference pattern).
- Add an objection handling line for "lock-in" that calls out the same API + export tooling.

End-of-day quick capture (placeholder):
- Dials: ___
- Connects: ___
- Demos booked: ___
- Notes for tomorrow: ___

Random snippets:
- If asked about quantization: mention 8-bit/4-bit options + tradeoffs (latency vs quality).
- For privacy: mention KMS + VPC/private control plane + audit logs.

Notes to collaborate with Jesse: sync on Meridian security intake form — ask Jesse to add SOC2 summary and point to PRD.

Scratchpad thoughts (messy):
- Try one outreach thread targeting Head of Platform titles w/ a short subject line: "reducing inference cost at scale" — A/B test on mornings vs afternoons.
- Reminder: check the Dedicated capacity availability for EMEA region before promising timeline.

-- Taylor
